questions.question: What news did Isaiah bring King Hezekiah in chapter 38?
options: His own sons would soon be carried off as captives to Babylon
He was sick and would die; set his house in order
His many enemies would very soon lay siege to the whole city
A great and terrible famine would soon strike the whole land
questions.answer: He was sick and would die; set his house in order
